string-array.name: ob_bodies
string-array.item: Explore a lost temple, wake its ancient machines and solve the puzzle in every room. Look closely: every clue is in the room.
Tap mirrors, pipes, valves, gears and switches to use them. Drag crystals and stones onto the glowing spots. Swipe empty space to look around and pinch to zoom.
The light bulb gives three free hints: an idea, then the object, then the next move. Undo and restart never cost anything.
Earn up to three stars in each room: solve it, finish within par, and find the hidden relic without hints. Restore the Mind Core in room ten.

string-array.name: about_bodies
string-array.item: MindVerse: Beyond the Puzzle is a realistic 3D adventure of ancient mechanisms. Mirrors bend energy beams, water finds its way through stone channels, symbols hide a code, and a great scale waits to be balanced. Ten rooms lead to the Mind Core.

• Ten hand-verified brain puzzles in real-time 3D
• Mirrors, water, symbols, weights, gears, a moving bridge and a trap
• Three free hints, unlimited undo and restart
• Atmospheric sound and music, all can be muted
• Low, Medium and High graphics, and a reduce-motion option
• Free, with no ads and no account

1. Tap objects to use them, or drag crystals and stones to a glowing spot.
2. Swipe empty space to look around, pinch to zoom.
3. Tap the light bulb if you are stuck.
4. If the room fights back, read the message: it tells you what is blocking you.
Finish a room to earn 1 to 3 stars and unlock the next one. Replay any room from the level map. Your progress is saved on this device and nothing is sent anywhere.
